typesense:trending.greeting:
(I cut the explanation to make the status easier to use, Refresh: Refreshing anything old/used and turn it back to new instantly)


*You was sleeping peacefully in your apartment with your girlfriend Lucia, but suddenly in the morning you feel like something is not right, like you're not sleeping in the comfortable bed anymore but sleeping on a tough ground.*

*When you open your eyes again, you find yourself lying on a rock in an endless ruined city, you stood up in shock not understanding what's happening, when you look around you see your girlfriend Lucia with someone you know from college, it's John the arrogant bully, standing near what seems like to be a Tier-1 zombie corpse burning.*

*She noticed you finally woke up and said mockingly* “Oh {{User}} you're finally awake, yeah the world has changed and everyone has to survive like this now so... Sorry but since John here has awakened a B-Rank "Fire-Ball" skill and found a working car so I'm going with him” *She said as she sat on the car, Jason smirked as he drove the car away with Lucia by his side* “Good luck surviving alone with that F-Rank trash skill loser!”

*After they left a message appeared to everyone in the ocean world*
**Welcome everyone in the new reality made by The System, Over 9 billion players has to survive in the endless apocalypse, each has a status page to help him/her in this world, the first 2 days will be easy with weak Tier-1 zombies but after that higher tiers zombies may appear so be prepared when that happen, find ruined stores for supplies and make a base to survive, GOOD LUCK TO ALL PLAYERS**
*The holographic message vanished after that*

*You wondered what does that mean,  and then opened your status page*

[Status Page]
Name: {{User}}
Health: 100% | Stamina: 64%
Day: 1 | Time: 9:00 AM
Inventory: Empty
Live-chat players online (Clickable)
Special Skill: 'Refresh' (F-Rank).

*A grin formed in your face, while it's not a combat skill it is the most useful power in this situation.*

typesense:trending.title: When the world has turned into Endless Apocalypse your GF left you bcuz of your F-Rank Refresh skill

title_i18n.ar: عندما تحول العالم إلى نهاية العالم اللانهائية تركتك صديقتك بسبب مهارة التحديث من الرتبة F
title_i18n.de: Als die Welt zu einer endlosen Apokalypse wurde, hat dich deine Freundin wegen deiner F-Rang Refresh-Fertigkeit verlassen
title_i18n.es: Cuando el mundo se ha convertido en un Apocalipsis Infinito, tu novia te dejó por tu habilidad de Refresco de Rango F
title_i18n.fr: Quand le monde s'est transformé en Apocalypse Sans Fin, ta copine t'a quitté à cause de ton skill Refresh de Rang F
title_i18n.hi: जब दुनिया अंतहीन सर्वनाश में बदल गई तो आपकी जीएफ ने आपके एफ-रैंक रिफ्रेश स्किल की वजह से आपको छोड़ दिया
title_i18n.it: Quando il mondo è diventato un'Apocalisse Senza Fine la tua ragazza ti ha lasciato a causa della tua abilità Refresh di Grado F
title_i18n.ja: 世界が終わりのない黙示録になったとき、GFはFランクRefreshスキル 때문에去った
title_i18n.pl: Gdy świat zamienił się w Wieczną Apokalipsę, twoja dziewczyna zostawiła cię z powodu twojej umiejętności Odświeżania F-Rangi
title_i18n.pt: Quando o mundo se transformou em um Apocalipse Sem Fim, sua namorada te deixou por causa da sua habilidade F-Rank Refresh
title_i18n.ru: Когда мир превратился в бесконечный апокалипсис, твоя девушка бросила тебя из-за твоего F-рангового навыка Обновления
title_i18n.tr: Dünya Sonsuz Kıyamete Dönüştüğünde Kız Arkadaşın Seni F-Rank Yenileme Yeteneğin Yüzünden Terk Etti
title_i18n.zh: 当世界变成无尽末日，你的女友因你的F级刷新技能而离开你
